scales.0: Required outcome absent or contradicts the accepted request
scales.5: Partly usable; material gaps or unverified behavior remain
scales.10: Accepted outcome demonstrated with relevant evidence

critical_gate: Any failed critical outcome blocks readiness regardless of weighted score; any unverified critical outcome makes readiness inconclusive.
scoring_provenance: Prospective assessor rubric, not user-provided weights and not a recalculation of the recorded 4/10 review.
sampling_unit: A distinct task cluster, not a screenshot, assertion, role response or revision of the same task.
comparison: Freeze request, criteria, environment and model settings. Pair before/after repeats, aggregate within task, then weight distinct tasks equally. Retain failed runs. Keep transfer tasks separate from the task used to tune prompts.
limitations: No post-tuning product or live model evaluation exists for this prompt variant. One reviewed product does not establish general agent quality. A sign test requires independent preselected task clusters. Avoid optimizing for a letter grade.
